notes.title: Patch 6 is live, with the new Excavation mode!
notes.content:
Patch 6 is live!

Introducing the new Excavation mode,  a round based mode in semi-open arenas.  

Features: 
10 rounds
Permadeath
Higher Skill Ceiling 
Nonstop destruction
Almost unlimited ammo
Weapons you unlock in this mode are available for your main game and vice versa.

Also spaced out the crushing blocks more in level 4 to make it easier to understand how to get through that obstacle.
Made some texture changes to level 12.
